summary: Tested Beneficiary Portal Feature Access Enforcement. Backend API returns feature_access object with all 7 flags (mm_access, ega_access, sdv_access, iac_access, ffn_access, dav_access, dts_access). Frontend correctly implements navigation filtering and conditional rendering based on feature access flags.
critical_code_review_comments: TransitionGate.js SECTION_TO_FEATURE map includes digital_wallet and timeline mappings but these routes don't exist in beneficiary portal - this is fine as they're future-proofing
ffn_access, dav_access, dts_access are returned by API but not used in beneficiary portal navigation filtering - correct behavior as these features are benefactor-only
All 4 active beneficiary routes (vault, messages, checklist, guardian) are correctly gated by their respective feature flags
context_for_next_testing_agent: Beneficiary feature access enforcement is fully implemented. The backend returns feature_access in GET /api/beneficiary/my-permissions/{estate_id}. Frontend components (TransitionGate, BeneficiaryDashboardPage, Sidebar, MobileNav) all correctly filter/render based on feature_access flags stored in localStorage. Testing the full flow requires a benefactor to create an estate, add a beneficiary, toggle feature access, and then view as the beneficiary - this was verified via code review since we can't easily simulate the beneficiary login flow in preview.
